resolutions.researcher_notes: Original current_ref (shafaq Khor Mor exclusive) is dead (HTTP 404); not archivable/needed since better sources exist. GEM Status = 'construction'. Rudaw Arabic (Feb 2022) reports the EPC agreement (KRG MNR with Kar Group, ~Jan 2021, 16-month build) and Iraq Oil Report notes the EPC contract was signed Dec 2021 and 'implementation has already begun' — both corroborate that the line was UNDER CONSTRUCTION through 2021-2022. IMPORTANT DISAGREEMENT: the pipeline was inaugurated by PM Masrour Barzani on 28 Oct 2025 (Shafaq, thenewregion, kurdistan24), so Status should now be updated to 'operating' — 'construction' is stale. Two independent sources for the construction-phase value.
Fuel = Gas. Every source describes this as a natural gas pipeline (Rudaw Arabic, Iraq Oil Report, Shafaq inauguration coverage). Two independent working sources; unambiguous.

PipelineType = transmission. Sources describe a ~192-198 km inter-governorate trunk line carrying gas from the Khurmala/Khor Mor fields across the Kurdistan Region (Erbil to Duhok) with spare capacity for future export destinations — clearly a transmission/trunk pipeline, not distribution. No source uses the controlled-vocab word 'transmission' literally, so tier medium (classification inferred from length/function).

GEM ProposalYear = 2022, but sources CONTRADICT this: the EPC contract was signed with Kar Group in Dec 2021 (Iraq Oil Report) and Rudaw Arabic (Feb 2022) references an agreement dated ~Jan 2021. A signed EPC contract in late 2021 means the project was proposed/agreed by 2021, not 2022. No working source corroborates a 2022 proposal date; evidence points to 2021 (or earlier). Marking UNRESOLVED and flagging the disagreement — ProposalYear likely should be 2021.

ConstructionYear = 2022. Iraq Oil Report: EPC contract signed Dec 2021 and 'implementation has already begun' (article early 2022); Rudaw Arabic (Feb 2022) cites a 16-month completion timeline from the agreement. Construction was underway in 2022 — corroborated by two independent sources. (Note: the ~Dec 2021 EPC could arguably place construction start in late 2021, but 2022 is consistent with active build.)

Diameter = 52 in. Rudaw Arabic explicitly states '52 inches' Erbil-to-Duhok; Iraq Oil Report describes 'a new 52-inch pipeline to Dohuk'. Two independent working sources agree exactly. Verifier confirmed the token '52' on both pages. High confidence.

FuelSource = 'Eribl' (typo of Erbil, the pipeline's start point). Sources confirm gas is fed from the Khurmala gas field to Erbil and onward to Duhok (Rudaw), i.e. the line originates in the Erbil area (Iraq Oil Report: 'laid from Khurmala to the power station in Duhok'). The upstream gas field is actually Khurmala (Rudaw) / Khor Mor (later 2025 coverage), so 'Erbil' reflects the pipeline start rather than the field name. Tier medium given the typo and the source-vs-start ambiguity.

Location: start Erbil, end Duhok, both in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq. Shafaq ('198-kilometer pipeline linking Erbil and Duhok'), Rudaw Arabic, and Kurdistan24 all confirm the Erbil->Duhok routing within Iraqi Kurdistan. Multiple independent working sources; high confidence. (Note GEM StartLocation is blank — the start is Erbil/Khurmala.)

Owner1 = Kurdistan Regional Government, 100%. The project is a KRG project: the KRG Ministry of Natural Resources signed the EPC contract (Iraq Oil Report) and PM Masrour Barzani inaugurated it as a KRG government project (thenewregion, Shafaq). Kar Group is the EPC contractor/implementer (not owner). Two+ independent working sources support KRG ownership. High confidence.
